citations.quote: Getting Ghosted by your Clients?… Here is what you should Do!

situation.text: Clients ghosting by not responding or engaging further after initial contact.

citations.quote:
Stop sending Listings and Fact sheets!
2. Ask …. Have you found what you were looking for or…. You are still looking ?

strategy.text: Instead of sending more listings and fact sheets, directly ask the client if they have found what they were looking for or are still searching.
